field.label: Enable
field.help: Run mdns-bridge. The daemon needs at least two enabled entries on the Interfaces tab; until then the service stays stopped.

field.label: CARP dependency
field.help: For HA pairs only: run mdns-bridge only while this node is MASTER for the selected CARP virtual IP, so that only one firewall forwards mDNS at a time. Choose a VIP on one of the bridged networks. Leave empty on a single firewall. On the BACKUP node the service is shown as stopped; that is expected. When synchronizing mDNS Bridge to the peer, synchronize Virtual IPs as well.

field.label: Log decode warnings
field.help: Start mdns-bridge with -w, which logs mDNS packets it cannot decode and unsupported record types. Useful when a device is not discovered; noisy otherwise.

field.label: Disable IPv4
field.help: Do not forward mDNS over IPv4 on any interface.

field.label: Disable IPv6
field.help: Do not forward mDNS over IPv6 on any interface. IPv4 and IPv6 cannot both be disabled.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Applied to every packet received on any bridged interface, before any per-interface filter. Per-interface filters can narrow this further but cannot widen it. Allow forwards only names that match a listed service; deny forwards everything except names that match.

field.label: Common services
field.help: Common DNS-SD services. Combined with the custom filters below.

field.label: Custom filters
field.help: Additional filters, one per entry. A filter is one or more labels separated by dots: a service such as _matter, a host name such as Office-Printer, or both, such as Office-Printer._ipp. Labels are case sensitive. _tcp, _udp and local are not needed. In allow lists, list whole services; host names are best used in deny lists.
